# fw bench

> Reference of the fw bench command: Run local compute, exec or HTTP benchmarks; `perf run` is the monorepo build, size, startup, link, wasm, Workers and GPU…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/bench/

Run local compute, exec or HTTP benchmarks; `perf run` is the monorepo build, size, startup, link, wasm, Workers and GPU harness

## Usage

```bash
fw bench <silicon|exec|compare|http|perf>
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw bench silicon
fw bench exec
fw bench compare
fw bench http
fw bench perf
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
